items.summary: QUINCY, Calif., Jan. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Plumas Bank , a wholly-owned subsidiary of Plumas Bancorp, has announced recent changes to its credit administration leadership team. Effective Jan. 1, 2026, Kevin Kaiser, formerly senior vice president and credit administrator, has been promoted to executive vice president and chief credit officer. In addition, Ryan Riggan, formerly senior vice president and SBA credit manager, has assumed the role of credit administrator. Former Executive Vice President and Chief Credit Officer Jeff Moore announced his planned career retirement in October 2025, and Kaiser was named his successor. Moore’s last day was December 31, 2025. Kaiser, who joined Plumas Bank in 2014, offers extensive experience in commercial and agricultural lending and a deep knowledge of the bank’s markets gained during nearly 40 years in the industry.
